name: YouCam API Skin AI & eCommerce VTO Hackathon
deadlineAsWritten: Submission Period: Sep 29, 2026(12:00 pm Eastern Time) – Nov 2, 2026(11:45 am Eastern Time) (“Submission Period”).

requiredTechnologies.name: Devpost
requiredTechnologies.usage: Registration and submission platform for the hackathon.

requiredTechnologies.name: Perfect Corp. YouCam API
requiredTechnologies.usage: At least one YouCam API must be integrated into a working web or mobile application; judging references the Skin, Beauty, Fashion, Jewelry & Watch, Hair & Beard categories.

requiredTechnologies.name: YouCam AI Skin Analysis (Skin AI)
requiredTechnologies.usage: Named track/capability on the contest page: "Use YouCam's Skin AI, alone or combined with other YouCam APIs". Satisfies the "at least one API" requirement.

requiredTechnologies.name: YouCam Apparel / Virtual Try-On (VTO)
requiredTechnologies.usage: Generative Apparel Virtual Try-On is highlighted as an available capability and as the eCommerce VTO track.

requiredTechnologies.name: REST API (standard HTTP integration)
requiredTechnologies.usage: Contest page states the YouCam models are exposed on "a standard REST API that drops into any stack".

requiredTechnologies.name: YouCam API account (yce.perfectcorp.com/ai-api)
requiredTechnologies.usage: Entrants must create a free YouCam API account and redeem the code for 1,000 free API units.

requiredTechnologies.name: YouTube (or Vimeo; Youku per contest page)
requiredTechnologies.usage: Demo video must be publicly hosted; YouTube highly preferred.

requiredTechnologies.name: Public or shared code repository (e.g., Git hosting)
requiredTechnologies.usage: A repository URL with all source code, assets and instructions must be provided; specific host is not named.

requiredTechnologies.name: Agentic AI workflows
requiredTechnologies.usage: Contest page encourages but does not require building products that include "cutting-edge Agentic AI workflows"; no specific framework named.

requiredTechnologies.name: Third-party SDKs/APIs and open source components
requiredTechnologies.usage: Permitted if the entrant is authorized under the relevant terms/licenses and builds on top of the underlying product.

mandatoryRules.text: Entrants must be individuals at least the age of majority where they reside as of the time of entry, teams of such individuals, or organizations legally organized/incorporated at the time of entry.
Participants must be above the legal age of majority in their country of residence.
A team or organization must appoint and authorize one individual (the Representative), who must meet the eligibility requirements, to enter the Submission on their behalf.
Entrants must register on the Hackathon Website (youcam-api-skin-ai-ecommerce.devpost.com) by clicking 'Join Hackathon' and creating or logging in to a free Devpost account.
Entrants must create a free YouCam API account at https://yce.perfectcorp.com/ai-api (separate link for the India region).
The Project must be a working application that integrates at least one Perfect Corp. YouCam API and demonstrates clear consumer or eCommerce value.
The solution must be a functional web or mobile prototype integrating at least one YouCam API; judging references APIs from the Skin, Beauty, Fashion, Jewelry & Watch, Hair & Beard categories.
The Project must install and run consistently on its intended platform and function as depicted in the video and/or text description.

Projects must be newly created, or if pre-existing, significantly updated after the start of the Submission Period; Entrants must explain how the Project was significantly updated during the Submission Period.
If a Project integrates any third-party SDK, API and/or data, the Entrant must be authorized to use them under the tool's terms, conditions or licensing requirements.
Use of the YouCam API is subject to YouCam's Terms of Service and Perfect Corp.'s Terms of Service.
Submission must include a URL to the code repository containing all necessary source code, assets, and instructions required for the project to be functional.
The repository must be either public (with relevant licensing) or private and shared with contact_event@PerfectCorp.com.
Submission must include a text description explaining the features, functionality and demonstrating clear consumer or eCommerce/retail value.
Submission must include screenshots of the project.
Submission must include a 1–3 minute demo video showing the experience end-to-end; judges are not required to watch beyond three minutes.
The demo video must explain the YouCam API used in the submission.
The demo video must include footage showing the Project functioning on the device for which it was built.
The demo video must be uploaded and publicly visible on YouTube (highly preferred) or Vimeo (the contest page also lists Youku), and the link must be provided on the submission form.
Winners must participate in an exit interview and agree to be included in a blog article.

Entrant must provide access to a working Project for judging and testing via a link to a website, functioning demo, or test build; if the site is private, login credentials must be included in testing instructions.
The Project must be available free of charge and without restriction for testing, evaluation and use by Sponsor, Administrator and Judges until the Judging Period ends.
If the Project runs on proprietary or non-widely-available hardware, the Sponsor/Administrator may require the Entrant to provide physical access to the hardware.
All Submission materials must be in English, or an English translation of the demo video, text description, testing instructions and all other materials must be provided.
Open source software/hardware may be used provided the Entrant complies with applicable open source licenses and creates software that enhances and builds upon the underlying open source product.

Submissions remain the IP of their developers, but entrants grant the Sponsor a non-exclusive license to use the entry for judging and grant Sponsor/Devpost rights to promote the Submission and use names, likeness, voice and image during the Hackathon Period and for three years thereafter.
Registration Period: Sep 24, 2026 12:00 pm ET – Nov 2, 2026 11:45 am ET.
Submission Period: Sep 29, 2026 12:00 pm ET – Nov 2, 2026 11:45 am ET; all submission materials must be entered during this period.
Judging Period: Nov 3, 2026 – Nov 20, 2026; winners announced on or around Nov 24, 2026.

Drafts may be saved before the end of the Submission Period; after the Submission Period ends no changes or alterations to the Submission may be made (except modifications specifically permitted by Sponsor/Devpost for infringing or inappropriate material).
Stage One judging is pass/fail on whether the Project reasonably fits the theme and reasonably applies the required APIs/SDKs; only passing Submissions advance to Stage Two scoring.
Stage Two evaluates submissions on four equally weighted criteria; judges may judge solely on the text description, images and video and are not required to test the Project.
Ties are broken by the highest score in the first applicable criterion, then successive criteria; remaining ties are settled by a judges' vote.

Prize pool totals $6,000: 1st Place $2,500 + blog feature + Product/Developer Marketing meeting; 2nd Place $1,000 + same; 3rd Place $500 + same; Women in Tech Special Award $1,000; Rising Star Award (Student Only) $1,000.
A Project can only win one (1) prize; a team may win a maximum of one Placement Prize (1st–3rd) or one Special Award.
Winners are responsible for all fees and taxes associated with receiving the prize and may need to provide W-9 or W-8BEN forms.

Entering constitutes agreement to the Official Rules, the Devpost Terms of Service (incorporated by reference), binding individual arbitration under AAA rules, New York governing law, and consent to publicity use of personal information.
The Official Rules may be changed at any time; amended rules are posted on the Hackathon Website and prevail over any conflicting statements in other hackathon materials.

disqualificationRisks: Residents of, or organizations domiciled in, listed excluded countries/territories may not participate or receive a prize (including Afghanistan, Antarctica, Belarus, Brazil, China, Crimea, Cuba, Djibouti, Donetsk, Iran, Iraq, Italy, North Korea, Luhansk, Quebec, Russia, Somalia, Sudan, Ukraine, Venezuela, Vietnam, Western Sahara, and any other comprehensively OFAC-sanctioned country).
Employees, agents and representatives of Promotion Entities (Sponsor/Administrator), judges, companies employing a judge, their immediate family/household members, and affiliates are not eligible.
Any individual or organization whose participation would create a real or apparent conflict of interest, in the Sponsor's sole discretion, is not eligible.
The demo video must not include third party trademarks, or copyrighted music or other material unless the Entrant has permission to use it.

The Submission must be the Entrant's original work, solely owned by the Entrant, and must not violate the intellectual property or other rights (copyright, trademark, patent, contract, privacy) of any other person or entity.
Submitted content must not contain viruses, Trojan horses, worms, spyware or other disabling or malicious code.

A Project must not have been developed with, or derived from a project developed with, financial or preferential support from the Sponsor or Administrator (e.g., funding, investment, contract work, or a commercial license) prior to the end of the Submission Period; such projects may be disqualified.
Sponsor/Administrator may disqualify any entrant found tampering with the entry process or acting in violation of the Official Rules, inappropriately, unsportsmanlike, or in violation of law.
Providing false eligibility information for Special Awards may result in disqualification of the submission.

Prize award is subject to verification of identity, qualifications and role; winners must complete and return required affidavit/tax forms within ten (10) business days of being sent, or risk delay, disqualification or forfeiture.
